messages:
sophia: Quick question — after PTQ on the new reranker we saw a weird NDCG@10 drop on the pubeval set, but MRR is roughly the same. anyone seen anchor/doc-dup effects cause this before?

james: hmm sometimes duplicates or near-duplicates can change rank ties and nDCG more than MRR. do you have an example query where top docs shuffle?

sophia: yeah i pulled a couple. example: query id q_412 — two docs are near-identical snippets from the same article, ptq seems to prefer the shorter snippet -> pushes the higher-gain doc down.

oliver: can you run a deduped eval? quick check:

```
python tools/eval_rerank.py \
  --model rerank-xf-ptq8 \
  --queries data/pub/queries.jsonl \
  --candidates data/pub/cands.jsonl \
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr \
  --dedupe-by-url
```

oliver: did a smoke run and got: ndcg@10 0.621 -> 0.639 when deduped; mrr 0.482 -> 0.485. deploy-bot posted the artifact (s3://redwood-evals/1705554321/).

deploy-bot: Automated eval summary uploaded: ndcg@10:0.621, mrr:0.482, ndcg@10(dedup):0.639, mrr(dedup):0.485. Full diffs at s3://redwood-evals/1705554321/diff.html :robot_face:

maya: sounds like dataset curation issue not model regression. two quick asks: 1) add a stratified holdout that preserves article-level grouping to the eval harness, 2) add a metric that reports "duplication sensitivity" (delta ndcg between raw/dedup).
james: +1 on stratified holdout. also we should test whether different doc trimming (keep full paragraph vs snippet) changes PTQ behavior. sometimes quantization amplifies tokenization boundary effects.
sophia: plan: i'll run a small ablation tomorrow: (a) raw, (b) dedup-by-url, (c) group-by-article holdout, (d) keep-full-paragraph docs. will post numbers and sample queries where rank order flips.

maya: SGTM. please include a short script to reproduce the dedupe step so SRE/bench can re-run.

sophia: yep — i'll add the script and a short README in the eval artifact. tagging @james to help with the holdout split code. :thumbsup:

james: happy to help, will carve out time after standup.

sophia: filed follow-ups: GH issue #redwood/rerank-evals  (will link after I open). thanks all.
